data.legacyIntro: Official DGFiP files are archived and located using Etalab cadastral parcels. During sync, sales appear on the map as parcels are matched.
data.syncHelp: Archive every published year, apply corrections and match parcels. Restart an interrupted sync to resume.
data.importHelp: Targeted import and parcel matching. National files are archived before importing. Use nationwide sync for complete coverage.
data.dvfplusMethod: DVF+ is structured and geolocated by Cerema from official DVF records. Each source row describes a mutation. Only positive-price sales are shown. Locations represent transactions and may cover several parcels.
data.dvfplusLimits: The CSV source does not provide street addresses or exact room counts. Municipalities and cadastral parcels identify the location. Price/m² is limited to transactions with one premise and one parcel.
data.dvfplusCaution: Recent periods may be incomplete. Sales without coordinates remain in coverage counts and do not appear on the map. Medians are not property valuations. Do not use these data to re-identify people.
data.legacyHistory: Archived years remain available after they leave the official publication. Each new release replaces only its stated coverage period; versions are never added together. Coverage may be partial and late registrations may be missing.
data.legacyGrouping: The raw file has no unique transaction identifier. Adjacent rows sharing a date, amount, municipality and disposition are grouped; distinct sales may remain ambiguous. The median describes these groups and is not a market valuation.
data.legacyLocation: Sales without a matched parcel remain in import counts but do not appear on the map. Price/m² is calculated only for simple groups. Identical building areas can remain ambiguous. Near a department boundary, also import neighbouring departments.
data.legacyCaution: DVF does not cover Alsace, Moselle or Mayotte. Do not use these data to re-identify people.
